description: docs-kit K1: Doc Gen's project template and command files, the seed that fills them, and the project id registration the Mac makes first (routes/docs-routes.mjs, kb/doc-project-files.mjs, kb/project-roots.mjs). Roster: all eight paths are in ALL_ENDPOINTS (extension/server.mjs); the handler is reached from routes/doc-gen.mjs through the doc_gen group (routes/feature-routes.mjs), so with doc_gen off every one of these answers 404 feature_disabled. Every route resolves its project through the caller's own registrations (POST /kb/projects/register), so another user's project id answers 404 PROJECT_NOT_REGISTERED. Folders in a path are checked before any disk access; a folder that is reserved (auto_task), dotted, over-long or not a plain name answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. The 413 body limit (512 KB) and the malformed-JSON 400 are not declared per route (SCHEMA.md). Rate limits: PUT and DELETE under /kb/docs/ and POST /kb/docs/seed and /kb/projects/register share the kbWrite bucket (429 is not declared: the bucket answers it for every kbWrite route). The Template and Command objects mirror the Swift DocTemplate and DocCommand Codable shapes, so the Mac decodes them with its existing models.

id.description: Stable UUID for the folder (SHA-256 of llmide.doc-template.<folder>, uppercase).

name.description: The '# Title' line, or the humanized folder name.

sections.description: The '## ' headings, or ['Content'] when there are none.

rawContent.description: The file text exactly as stored.

id.description: Stable UUID for the folder (SHA-256 of llmide.doc-command.<folder>, uppercase).

name.description: The first '# ' line, or the humanized folder name.

instruction.description: The body without the first '# ' line and the marker line.

project.description: A registered project id (1 to 128 letters, digits, _ or -). Required: a request without it answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

name.description: Title, at most 200 characters. Defaults to the folder name.

sections.description: Section headings, at most 100 of 200 characters each. Used when rawContent is absent.

surface.description: doc (default) or visual. Any other value answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

rawContent.description: The whole file text. When present it is written as-is (the Swift renderedMarkdown rule).

rewrite.description: With no rawContent: apply name and sections to the existing file and keep its body text (DocTemplate.rewriting).

root.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Must exist, must not be a symlink, must not be the filesystem root, the home directory or an ancestor of it, and must contain system/project.json.
